source: qloo mcp (listTools + qloo_capabilities), no credential, no workflow calls

tools.name: qloo_capabilities
tools.title: Inspect Qloo MCP capabilities
tools.description: Inspect the canonical Qloo workflow contract, checksum, and this server's exact execution readiness without contacting Qloo.

tools.name: qloo_recommend
tools.title: Find entities for a taste profile, audience, or collection of signals.
tools.description: Find Qloo entities related to one combined entity, tag, location, and demographic taste profile. Signals influence affinity; filters constrain output.

target_type.description: Qloo Insights entity type: artist, book, brand, movie, person, place, podcast, tv_show, videogame.

signals.description: Named entities or Qloo entity UUIDs; use tag fields for abstract concepts.

signal_tags.description: Genres, moods, styles, traits, or other concepts, or Qloo tag URNs; not named entities.

signal_tags_operator.description: Combine tag values with union (any) or intersection (all).

demographic.description: Audience demographic in natural language, such as 'young women', 'men 25-34', or 'millennials'. It is converted to documented Qloo demographic signals.

include_tags.description: Genres, moods, styles, traits, or other concepts, or Qloo tag URNs; not named entities.

include_tags_operator.description: Combine tag values with union (any) or intersection (all).

exclude_tags.description: Genres, moods, styles, traits, or other concepts, or Qloo tag URNs; not named entities.

exclude_tags_operator.description: Combine tag values with union (any) or intersection (all).

tools.name: qloo_rank
tools.title: Rank a supplied set of options for signals, location, or audience.
tools.description: Rank one supplied option set against one shared entity, location, demographic, and tag profile. Scores from separate calls are not comparable.

options.description: Named entities or Qloo entity UUIDs; use tag fields for abstract concepts.

option_type.description: Qloo Insights entity type: artist, book, brand, movie, person, place, podcast, tv_show, videogame.

signals.description: Named entities or Qloo entity UUIDs; use tag fields for abstract concepts.

demographic.description: Audience demographic in natural language, such as 'young women', 'men 25-34', or 'millennials'. It is converted to documented Qloo demographic signals.

include_tags.description: Genres, moods, styles, traits, or other concepts, or Qloo tag URNs; not named entities.

exclude_tags.description: Genres, moods, styles, traits, or other concepts, or Qloo tag URNs; not named entities.

tools.name: qloo_describe
tools.title: Resolve and describe one Qloo entity.
tools.description: Resolve one named entity or Qloo UUID and return only metadata present in Qloo.

type.description: Qloo search entity type: artist, book, brand, movie, person, place, podcast, tv_show, videogame, locality, actor, album, author, director.

tools.name: qloo_where_popular
tools.title: Find geographic areas where an entity has comparatively strong affinity.
tools.description: Find geographic areas where one entity has strong query-relative affinity. This is distinct from filtering recommendations to a place.

entity_type.description: Qloo search entity type: artist, book, brand, movie, person, place, podcast, tv_show, videogame, locality, actor, album, author, director.

within.description: Required geographic area that constrains the heatmap.

tools.name: qloo_compare_audiences
tools.title: Contrast two signal groups and identify shared or differentiating affinities.
tools.description: Compare two complete groups of entity signals in one Qloo analysis request.

group_a.description: Named entities or Qloo entity UUIDs; use tag fields for abstract concepts.

group_b.description: Named entities or Qloo entity UUIDs; use tag fields for abstract concepts.

target_type.description: Qloo Insights entity type: artist, book, brand, movie, person, place, podcast, tv_show, videogame.

tools.name: qloo_entity_tags
tools.title: Retrieve concepts and tags that characterize entities.
tools.description: Retrieve Qloo concepts that jointly characterize one or more entities using the documented urn:tag Insights workflow.

entities.description: Named entities or Qloo entity UUIDs; use tag fields for abstract concepts.

entity_type.description: Qloo search entity type: artist, book, brand, movie, person, place, podcast, tv_show, videogame, locality, actor, album, author, director.

tools.name: qloo_audience_demographics
tools.title: Retrieve aggregate audience segments associated with an entity.
tools.description: Retrieve aggregate demographic distributions associated with one entity through the documented urn:demographics Insights workflow.

entity_type.description: Qloo search entity type: artist, book, brand, movie, person, place, podcast, tv_show, videogame, locality, actor, album, author, director.

tools.name: qloo_trends
tools.title: Retrieve interest or trend information over a time range.
tools.description: Retrieve Qloo time-series popularity metrics for one to five resolved entities over an ISO date range.

entity_type.description: Qloo Insights entity type: artist, book, brand, movie, person, place, podcast, tv_show, videogame.

start_date.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

tools.title: Search the Qloo tag ontology by natural-language concept.
tools.description: Search Qloo's tag ontology by natural-language concept and return stable tag URNs.
